assets.purpose: Primary interface typeface for the complete Lokr workspace.
requirements: Variable upright font with weights 400, 500, and 700 available.
Local file verified as TrueType with magic bytes 00010000.
SIL Open Font License 1.1 is stored beside the font.
Build must verify document.fonts.ready, a loaded Geist FontFace, document.fonts.check, and tabular-number rendering.

source.license: SIL Open Font License 1.1. Original Google Fonts source commit and SHA-256 are recorded in apps/web/public/fonts/PROVENANCE.json.

assets.purpose: Monospace typeface for non-sensitive object IDs and keys only.
requirements: Variable upright font with weight 400 available.
Local file verified as TrueType with magic bytes 00010000.
SIL Open Font License 1.1 is stored beside the font.
Use only for visible non-sensitive IDs and keys, never as the general interface face. Build must verify loaded FontFace and document.fonts.check.
